remarks: Rare multi-family opportunity in Stamford, CT! Just a 5-minute walk to the train station-ideal for NY commuters. The first-floor unit features an updated kitchen with granite countertops, newer stainless steel appliances, and one of the two full bathrooms is stylishly renovated, complete with a jacuzzi tub. The finished lower level provides additional living space. The second-floor unit spans two levels, offering generous living space and two full bathrooms. Outside, the property boasts beautifully landscaped grounds with a greenhouse and sprinkler system. A large two-car detached garage includes an attached "She Shed," perfect for hobbies, storage, or a private retreat. Other updates include two new furnaces and two new hot water tanks. This property is ideal for savvy investors, or homeowners wanting to offset their mortgage with rental income. Schedule your showing today.
